headline: **MLB Daily Roundup: June 6, 2026**
article:
The San Francisco Giants dominated the Chicago Cubs in a blowout victory, winning 18-3 behind a strong performance from their offense. Matt Chapman led the Giants' charge with 2 home runs and 8 RBIs. The Philadelphia Phillies outlasted the Chicago White Sox 8-6, securing a crucial win. Randal Grichuk led the White Sox offense with 2 home runs and 2 RBIs.

Several key players are dealing with injuries, impacting their teams' lineups. Tyler Glasnow has been transferred from the 15-day injured list to the 60-day injured list by the Los Angeles Dodgers due to low back spasms. Austin Wells has been placed on the 10-day injured list by the New York Yankees with cervical headaches. Gustavo Campero and Jorge Soler have been placed on the 10-day injured list by the Los Angeles Angels due to a right hand fracture and left oblique strain, respectively.

There have been several trades and roster movements in the MLB. The Boston Red Sox acquired Joe La Sorsa from the Pittsburgh Pirates. The Cincinnati Reds traded Kyle Nicolas to the Baltimore Orioles for cash. The Los Angeles Angels traded Austin Wynns to the Atlanta Braves for cash. The Minnesota Twins traded Simeon Woods Richardson to the Toronto Blue Jays for cash. The Pittsburgh Pirates traded Justin Lawrence to the Minnesota Twins for cash.

top_news.title: **Mariners Fall to Tigers in 7-3 Showdown**
top_news.summary: The Seattle Mariners suffered a 7-3 loss to the Detroit Tigers, with Kerry Carpenter leading the Tigers' offense. Carpenter hit a home run and drove in two runs in the game.

top_news.title: **Phillies Take Down White Sox in Thrilling 8-6 Victory**
top_news.summary: The Philadelphia Phillies outlasted the Chicago White Sox 8-6, securing a crucial win. Randal Grichuk led the White Sox offense with 2 home runs and 2 RBIs.

top_news.title: **Red Sox Take Down Yankees 5-3**
top_news.summary: The Boston Red Sox secured a 5-3 victory over the New York Yankees, with Sonny Gray earning the win. Willson Contreras led the Red Sox offense with a 2-hit, 1-home run, 3-RBI performance.

top_news.title: **Mariners Shut Out Tigers 4-0**
top_news.summary: The Seattle Mariners secured a dominant 4-0 victory over the Detroit Tigers, with Bryce Miller leading the way on the mound. Randy Arozarena and Dominic Canzone were among the impact hitters for the Mariners.

top_news.title: **Royals Edge Twins in Thrilling 3-2 Victory**
top_news.summary: The Kansas City Royals secured a narrow win over the Minnesota Twins, with Carter Jensen and Bobby Witt Jr. leading the charge offensively.

top_news.title: **Glasnow Shifted to 60-Day IL**
top_news.summary: Los Angeles Dodgers right-hander Tyler Glasnow has been transferred from the 15-day injured list to the 60-day injured list due to low back spasms.

top_news.title: **La Sorsa Traded to Boston**
top_news.summary: The Boston Red Sox acquired LHP Joe La Sorsa in a trade. The Pittsburgh Pirates sent La Sorsa to the Red Sox.
